transcript: I prefer society that emphasizes the role of law, sustainability, and innovation. This value promotes stability, prosperity, and freedom while supporting long-term processes. A rank low tech and faith-based model lower because they may place greater emphasis on conformity or limited personal freedom, technological progress, and modern living standards.
